transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Member Services. My name is Julian. May I have your name, please?
Customer: Hi Julian, this is Sabrina Kowalczyk.
Agent: Hello, Ms. Kowalczyk. For security verification, could you confirm your billing zip code and the last four digits of your card?
Customer: Sure, the zip is 48201 and the last four digits are 9043.
Agent: Thank you. How can I assist you with your account today?
Customer: I'm looking at my statement and there's a charge from Lumen & Loft Decor for $310.00 from September 7th that I need help with.
Agent: I see that transaction on September 7th for $310.00. Can you tell me what happened with that purchase?
Customer: Well, I ordered a wall mirror, but when it arrived, it didn't really fit my space, so I decided to send it back.
Agent: Okay, you returned the item. When did you send that back to them?
Customer: It was maybe a week or so after it came, probably around mid-September. I just packaged it up and mailed it out.
Agent: Do you happen to have a tracking number for that package?
Customer: Honestly, no. I looked everywhere for the slip from the post office, but I can't find it. I don't have any tracking details.
Agent: Understood. Have you heard back from Lumen & Loft Decor confirming that the mirror arrived back at their warehouse?
Customer: No, I haven't gotten an email or anything saying they got it.
Agent: Have you spoken with their customer service at all about returning the item?
Customer: I sent a general message through their contact form on the website, but I haven't heard a direct reply.
Agent: Did anyone from the store ever tell you or promise that you would receive your money back?
Customer: I honestly can't say for sure. I just know what was on their website, but nobody specifically promised me a refund directly.
Agent: Let me make sure I have all the details noted properly. You made a purchase of $310.00 at Lumen & Loft Decor on September 7th for a mirror, and you shipped it back in mid-September without a tracking number.
Customer: Yes, exactly.
Agent: And you haven't received confirmation from the merchant that the item arrived, nor has anyone from the company confirmed that a refund would be issued.
